title: Extracted CIM value (Stage 1 output)
description: One entry per (row, period) pair, as extracted from the CIM's consolidated financial overview. This is what the LLM extraction step must produce, and what stage 2 validates before mapping.

row.description: Canonical financial line key, e.g. net_revenue, gross_profit, reported_ebitda, ebitda_adjustments, adjusted_ebitda.

period.description: Source-driven period label, e.g. FY2023A (actual) or FY2027E (estimate/forecast). Never a fixed example year.

value.description: The extracted value in the unit given below, or null when the period genuinely is not disclosed in the source. Never invented.

unit.description: The unit as reported in the source, before any stage-2 rescaling.

page.description: 1-indexed PDF page number the value was read from.

label.description: The line label exactly as printed in the source, e.g. "Adjustments to EBITDA".

confidence.description: Computed, not vibes: 1.0 only when schema/arithmetic/two_pass all pass. See docs/02-technical-requirements.md.

schema.description: True if the value parses to the declared type/unit.

arithmetic.description: True if margin/EBITDA-derived relationships reconcile for this value (e.g. reported_ebitda + ebitda_adjustments == adjusted_ebitda, within rounding).

two_pass.description: True only if two independent read attempts on the source agree within rounding.

review.description: True whenever confidence < config.review_threshold OR any check is false. Never silently cleared by a script -- only a human confirming the review workbook clears it.
